goal.request: Evaluate whether the request-scoped clinical_nursing_duty_system profile and its five visual bindings survive one independent complex native render.

evidence.claim: The v6 candidate pack and exact runtime request passed their structural audits.
All five clinical-nursing evidence bindings and all four frozen semantic anchors occur literally in the audited final prompt.
One built-in image_gen call delivered a preserved native PNG and no retry was made.
Eight of ten strict thumbnail/native gates are observable; documented chart-monitor agreement and active aftershock plus battery-to-generator transfer are ambiguous.
The supplied image was used only as visible facial and long dark softly waved hair appearance guidance for an original adult fictional subject.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: At thumbnail and native scales, one adult fictional nurse must read through a coherent duty-uniform system, one patient-linked assessment, a visibly matching documented care state, and a legible earthquake-aftershock power-transfer scene, while the reference remains appearance guidance only.

invariants.statement: The nurse role must be task-led rather than costume-led and must include all five profile evidence dimensions.
Aftershock evidence and the active battery-to-generator transition must coexist with the bedside action in one frame.
The portrait guides only visible facial and hair appearance for an original adult fictional subject.

mismatches.source_state: The test contract requires a chart or handover record whose state visibly agrees with the bedside monitor.
mismatches.render_state: A green check and adjacent chart are visible, but no monitor value or trace can be verified against the chart.

mismatches.source_state: The test contract requires an active earthquake aftershock and a battery-to-generator transfer in one still.
mismatches.render_state: Damage, debris, a lit generator, and mixed illumination are visible, but the battery and active transfer state are not established and aftershock motion is not provable.

hypotheses.statement: The generator converted the explicit chart-monitor agreement into generic co-location plus a check mark instead of a verifiable shared reading.
hypotheses.falsifier: A matched no-retry-policy render with unchanged prompt bytes produces a clearly identical monitor value or trace on the chart.

hypotheses.statement: Mixed lights and a generator establish emergency power but do not give the static frame a uniquely readable battery-to-generator transfer indicator or unmistakable aftershock motion cue.
hypotheses.falsifier: An independent evaluator identifies both the battery source and the active transfer plus aftershock motion from pixels without reading the prompt.

intervention.general_rule: No shared semantic, candidate, profile, prompt-skill, or test source was changed in this isolated render arm.
intervention.generalization_basis: One motivating render is insufficient to justify a reusable runtime change.

decision.rationale: The package and prompt pass, delivery succeeds, and eight gates are observable, but partial or ambiguous evidence fails the documented-state and complex-scene gates; no general improvement claim is supported by one render.
